'''Why won't you listen!''' (Japanese: '''いうことをきかない！''' ''It Won't Obey!'') is the second episode of ''[[A Pocketful of Adventures]]''. It first aired in Japan on October 27, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
{{spoilers}}

==Plot==
==Major events==
* Madoka is introduced to Sora, Masako's son.
* Kageaki Hiyama starts playing Pokémon Red on his own.

==Characters==

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Farfetch'd}}

==Trivia==
* The fact that Farfetch'd's [[original Trainer]] is a Gentleman is a possible reference to [[Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!]], where a Gentleman is considering trading his Farfetch'd for a Spearow. In the [[Generation I]] games, Farfetch'd's original Trainer is a {{tc|Lass}}.
** It may also be a reference to the [[Pokémon Trader (Base Set 77)|Pokémon Trader]] card from the {{TCG|Base Set}} of the {{pkmn|Trading Card Game}}, which features a man wearing attire similar to that of a Gentleman.
